mood: Rivals made one team, a box of chocolate, and a raid by the sea beside the Academy's famous pair.

hero.alt: Fanny smiles warmly as she speaks, in her white shirt and red bow tie.
hero.credit: Official short animation, Layla and Fanny

media.alt: In freeform training Layla fires her cannon, and one drone drops at her feet with crosses for eyes.
media.credit: Official short animation, Layla and Fanny

inserts.speaker: layla
inserts.line: Why am I always the one getting hurt...?

media.alt: Fanny slashes through a flock of drones, then stands puzzled beside a scowling Layla and a heap of wrecks.
media.credit: Official short animation, Layla and Fanny

media.alt: Layla smirks, leaps the gap between roofs and lands with her arms spread, scoring 10 points.
media.credit: Official short animation, Layla and Fanny

media.alt: Fanny streaks past on her cables and lands on a much higher roof while Layla gapes from below.
media.credit: Official short animation, Layla and Fanny

inserts.speaker: layla
inserts.line: Hah, you won't be beating me this time!

media.alt: Layla beams over a tall stack of wrapped gift boxes, then smiles a smug little smile.
media.credit: Official short animation, Layla and Fanny

media.alt: Layla holds a gift box and watches Fanny walk in through a door with nothing in her hands.
media.credit: Official short animation, Layla and Fanny

inserts.speaker: layla
inserts.line: Ah, she didn't get chocolate, did she?

inserts.speaker: layla
inserts.line: Fanny, did you get any chocolate? I've received tons!

media.alt: A wall of gift boxes appears beside Fanny, and Layla stares, then turns her back in a huff.
media.credit: Official short animation, Layla and Fanny

inserts.speaker: layla
inserts.line: I'll win next time for sure!

media.alt: Layla sulks at her desk, arms folded, until Fanny sets a pink box with a teal ribbon in front of her.
media.credit: Official short animation, Layla and Fanny

inserts.speaker: fanny
inserts.line: This is for you, my teammate!

inserts.speaker: layla
inserts.line: For me? Well..... It'd sure be rude of me not to accept your kind gift!

media.alt: Layla jumps in surprise at her desk, then pouts and keeps the box while Fanny stands beside her.
media.credit: Official short animation, Layla and Fanny

media.alt: Terrinia from high above: towers around a blue bay that opens to the sea, a great tower sending light into the sky.
A small drawing of the pair: black-haired Vexana smiling faintly behind pink-haired Guinevere, who cheers with a fist up.

inserts.caption: Guinevere and Vexana, the Academy's undefeated pair.

media.alt: Guinevere and Vexana fight back to back among Enders, Guinevere with her fists up and two cat-eared drones, Vexana with her staff.
